description: Defines a class IncludeEmployee that extends FilterField, used to modify database query builders for filtering employee records based on termination status within an HR management system.

classes.name: IncludeEmployee
classes.description: A filter field class for including employees based on their termination record status.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Modifies the query builder to filter employees by termination status based on the operator (null or not null).

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the entity alias used in the query, which is 'employee'.
